what: Visual-QA rebuild of arrow; low-poly diorama prop, readable from the isometric camera.

dims.basis: Shipped arrow.glb measured by verify_models.py: 0.160 x 0.184 x 1.020 u; keep the same footprint and height. Visual-QA fix: clear leaf blade, compact fletching. Rebuilt mesh measured by validate_glb; footprint follows the new silhouette. Second pass: broad gold flights and a larger leaf point. Rebuilt mesh measured by validate_glb (second pass).

views.why: Reads at gameplay scale beside a 1.55 u human; 60 px inset used in the contact sheet.

style_notes: Low-poly diorama, flat palette colours from docs/ART_DIRECTION.md, no textures. Never: smooth shading, plain unbroken boxes, invented hues.
notes: Visual-QA rebuild: bmesh parts, bevels, weighted normals, packed UV0; replaces assets/models/arrow.glb.
